name: hair
description: Haircuts, colour and styling, at a salon or at home.

homeVisits.description: True when the seller comes to the buyer's place.

howDealsGo: The buyer pays into escrow at booking and releases after the appointment, or pays and releases in one tap at the end. Done is the cut or colour as agreed. A timer to the seller, set past the appointment, pays for work done if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying, show a photo of what you want.
